level: segment comparison of a device-driver byte/register stream (no audio comparison)

emulator.name: dosbox-automation
emulator.config: bridge default (VGA, MPU-401 and Sound Blaster/OPL present, default cycles)

recipe: MT-32 (the game's own auto-detection picks it with the default config): node scripts/dosbox/trace-calls.mjs cbd0 700 --arm main --out .local/dosbox-mpu-trace.json, then type: C: <Enter>, dtrack <Enter>

AdLib (restart DOSBox; DS:2d2a = 3 is the device-selection word the original never writes): node scripts/dosbox/trace-calls.mjs c8c6,c937 300 --arm main --poke 2d2a:3 --mem 2dba:4,2dbe:1 --out .local/adl.json, then type the same commands

combine: mt32.queued = AL at every 1000:cbd0 entry (the MIDI byte queued); adlib.writes = (AL, AH) at every 1000:c8c6 entry; adlib.delays = words DS:2dba, DS:2dbc at the return of 1000:c8e5 (1000:c937)
injections: none: the port runs from the program start with the sound option set; AdLib selection is made by the port's ports (MPU absent), DOSBox's by DS:2d2a

comparison.mt32: the first 692 MIDI bytes the port queues equal the DOSBox bytes (the last bytes of the capture may still be queued in DOSBox)
comparison.adlib: OPL register writes through 1000:c8c6 equal DOSBox for all 299 captured; the detection calibration words [2dba],[2dbc] equal
comparison.timing: not compared: byte and register times are APPROX (devices.js cost.usPerPort calibrated from the detection count)
